legal_assessment.civil_concursal_registry: On the current record the 26-Jun-2018 Auto used the then-available Article 197.6 LC mechanism and was operative within its express scope; nothing located establishes that it was void. Its wording suspended only the listed mortgaged-finca realisation lane and left other estate liquidation unchanged. That literal scope gave the AC a non-frivolous implementation defence, but did not itself amend the approved unitary architecture, cancel ob rem links or supply prior judicial authorisation for the separate 28-Nov deed. The signed 24-Oct-2019 Auto is the controlling corrective decision: it characterised the partial approach as erroneous in light of the unitary plan, found the separate transaction lacked prior judicial authorisation, set aside the 12-Dec LAJ direction and refused convalidation.
legal_assessment.criminal_investigative: Error, an adverse ruling or later correction does not establish procedural fraud, judicial prevaricación or a punishable-insolvency offence. A procedural-fraud hypothesis requires a specified deception or manipulation, the recipient court, actual judicial error, an economically prejudicial resolution and actor-specific causation. Because the deed preceded the 12-Dec LAJ direction, that direction cannot have caused execution of the already signed deed. Any criminal hypothesis must identify another causal representation/use chain. The phrase 'estafa concursal' is retained only as party shorthand, not as a standalone adjudicated offence.
legal_assessment.professional_duty: The 28-Dec notice, 4-Jan delivery and 9-Jan follow-up are affirmative protective acts and defeat a total-abandonment formulation against Cuatrecasas. They also create a finite knowledge/follow-through benchmark: mandate, advice, standing analysis, judicial/Registry steps, response to the qualification, restitution/accounting work, client warnings, limitation advice, file handover and later fee enforcement must be tested separately. A fee-enforcement procedural-fraud theory requires the exact allegedly deceptive representation/title, judicial reliance, resulting decision and patrimonial loss; no common plan with CAM, the AC or the judge is established by this chain.
contrary_exculpatory: The 26-Jun Auto expressly permitted liquidation of other estate assets to continue.
The Registrar gave a reasoned standing and qualification-scope response rather than remaining silent.
Cuatrecasas performed a documented protective Registry intervention and follow-up.
The 24-Oct-2019 Auto corrected the earlier procedural state and refused convalidation.
No controlled source presently proves a coordinated plan, knowing judicial injustice or criminal intent by any actor.
